stories.headline: Tinubu seeks N3.15tn cut in 2026 budget, retains N31.46tn deficit

stories.why: Nigeria's federal budget sets public spending and borrowing needs for Africa's largest economy, shaping its fiscal outlook, naira-denominated debt and investor sentiment toward its sovereign bonds.

stories.headline: Noboa announces increase of Ecuador's minimum wage to $500 for 2027

stories.headline: US files lawsuit to recover millions of dollars stolen in cyberattack on Binance
stories.summary: The Justice Department filed a forfeiture complaint to recover more than $1.1 billion in cryptocurrency allegedly stolen last month from Binance by North Korean hackers.

stories.summary: France and Nigeria signed three agribusiness agreements and an energy roadmap at French Week 2026 in Lagos, organised by the FNCCI. The event aims to deepen economic ties.
stories.why: Bilateral agribusiness and energy agreements can shape investment flows and trade in key sectors between the two economies.

stories.summary: Gold prices declined by 2% on Tuesday, with silver sliding 5.3%, as investors braced for upcoming US inflation data. Markets are pricing in a roughly 95% chance of a quarter-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December.
stories.why: Gold is often viewed as a hedge against inflation and interest rate volatility; its price is highly sensitive to Federal Reserve policy expectations.
stories.why_moved: Expectations of higher interest rates strengthen the US dollar and bond yields, putting downward pressure on gold prices.

stories.summary: UzBev warns that restricting white sugar imports could cause shortages and higher product prices, estimating sugar prices could rise 15-28%. It urges quotas to be suspended.
stories.why: Sugar is a key input for beverage producers, so import restrictions and supply gaps can raise input costs and consumer prices.
stories.original_headline: “Taqchillik va narxlarning keskin oshishiga olib boradi”. Ichimlik ishlab chiqaruvchilar shakar importiga kvotalarni qayta ko‘rib chiqishga chaqirdi
